items.title: Meta’s Muse just changed the AI game
items.summary: Is Meta finally catching up to OpenAI and Anthropic? In The Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen heads to Qualcomm's Snapdragon Summit in Maui to break down Meta's Muse: the AI model suddenly turning heads across the industry as a serious contender in the AI race. Then, Ejaaz sits down with Qualcomm CFO & COO Akash Palkhiwala for an inside look at how the chip giant is betting big on agentic AI, straight from one of tech's biggest stages.

items.title: Meta has 'enormous advantage' in rally sparked by new Muse AI
items.summary: Meta Platforms (META) stock is trying to hold onto gains from its latest rally fueled by the release of its new Muse AI chatbot. Is this another big moment for the Big Tech company or are investors still wary of trust concerns? Today's Market Hang panel consists of Host Turney Duff, Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi, Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski, Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick, and Gerber Kawasaki Wealth & Investment Management CEO Ross Gerber.

items.title: What Microsoft's Trailing Multiple Leaves Out
items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) has returned about 33% over the past three months, though it is down 3.1% over the past twelve months. Near $500 a share, the stock carries a trailing price-to-earnings ratio of about 26.7 times adjusted earnings. Whether that multiple looks elevated or not, it is the wrong number to make the decision on, because the earnings analysts already expect are not in it.
